delivery.outcome: Export a read-only exact-state adoption allocation plan from a verified immutable package and admit its independently recomputed prospective standard ownership through the native allocator before any adopter upgrade. Preserve external change authority and local overrides.
nonGoals: No self-issued policy enrollment, source-write lease, approval or publication authority
No source changes before independent exact admission
No target project tickets or source stored in the hub
No activation or runtime-wide all-tool enforcement in this slice

architecture.decision: A closed advisory plan binds immutable source identity, exact target HEAD and dirty state, current adoption pins, every current/desired path digest and prospective three-way manifest. Native allocation must independently validate/recompute it against the pinned published package; derive only standard-managed upgrade paths, preserve local overrides and construct complete delivery intent before allocation reservation digests. Missing or stale authority remains a refusal.
interfaceChanges: Native allocator consumption of independently verified exact plan
dataChanges: Advisory standard adoption plan schema; grantsAuthority=false
architecture.rollback: Revert material delivery through protected review; do not widen an adopter scope manually or mint local editing authority.

validation.evidence: Owning worktree receipts; read-only plan, pin/state/digest/path negative cases
Native exact ownership and complete intent creation; changed state and missing authority refuse
Required hub checks and atomic material version/package projections; independent exact-head delivery
